newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid heavy selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid heavy selling.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down on Saturday amid heavy selling by retail investors as they tried to escape from a falling market, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 65.28 points or 4.06 percent from Thursday to 1,541.27 on a turnover of 67.6 million taka.
Of 115 traded issues 104 lost and 10 gained.
"The market is experiencing a lingering bearishness. There has been panic selling by small investors in a falling market," said broker Sabbir Ahmed.
United Leasing Company shed 201 to 2,308, Singer Bangladesh fell 711 to 11,764 and Amam Sea Food was down 207 to 4,242.
